title: Check ten planned pen-test actions against the signed rules of engagement
situation: Our client signed rules of engagement for a 10-day penetration test, listing the in-scope networks, the excluded ones, allowed testing hours and banned techniques. Ten test actions are planned, some by a human tester and some by an AI testing agent. The client also needs five upcoming audits matched to the right type of assessment.
your_task: Check each planned action is signed off, inside the authorized dates and inside an in-scope target range.
Check the technique is allowed and the time is inside the testing window, with the stated exemption for passive research.
Mark each action ALLOW, BLOCK or NEEDS_APPROVAL, and name who must approve.
Match each audit need to the right assessment type, and whether it is internal or external.
why_it_matters: Testing outside the signed scope or hours is unauthorized access, which can break the law and take down a client's systems. Picking the wrong kind of audit can fail a regulator or customer requirement.
done_when: All 10 actions have a decision and a reason (2 allowed, 7 blocked, 1 needing approval).
The web-app test is held until the CISO gives written approval.
All 5 assessment needs are matched to a type, and the IAM team confirms the AI agent and tester accounts are disabled after day 10.

glossary.Penetration test: An authorized, simulated attack to find weaknesses before real attackers do.
glossary.Rules of engagement (RoE): The signed agreement that sets what testers may touch, how and when.
glossary.Scope: The list of systems that may be tested; anything else is off limits.
glossary.Passive vs active reconnaissance: Passive research reads public sources only; active research sends traffic to the target.
glossary.Attestation (SOC 2): An independent auditor's report on a company's controls.
glossary.CISO: Chief information security officer, the senior security leader.

talking_point: Gated 10 planned penetration-test actions against signed rules of engagement, allowing 2, blocking 7 for scope, time window, banned or unknown technique and expired authorization, and holding 1 for CISO approval, then matched 5 audit needs to the right assessment type.
